steps.description: Fit DESeq2 (~condition) on the filtered count matrix from T1S1. DE gene counts at FDR<0.05 reported per comparison, split by up/down direction
no genes dropped between the filtered matrix and the result tables other than by DESeq2's independent filtering, which is reported

steps.description: Produce volcano plots (EnhancedVolcano) and MA plots for treated_a vs control and treated_b vs control; a heatmap of the top DE genes (variance-stabilized values, samples ordered by condition) for the omnibus LRT set; an upset/Venn comparison of DE gene sets between the two treatments; and a scatter of treated_a vs treated_b shrunk log2FCs for the union DE set to show concordant vs treatment-specific responses. Write a compact tabular summary (per comparison: n_up, n_down, n_shared) next to the figures.

treated_a-vs-treated_b shared/unique/opcode DE counts tabulated and plotted

all figures and the summary table written to the step's output directory

if the GMT cannot be joined to the gene identifiers at all, the step reports the failure and exits without blocking the pipeline

plan.title: Three-group liver RNA-seq omnibus and per-treatment DE
plan.analytical_narrative: The data are raw gene-level Salmon counts for 12 human liver samples in three conditions (control, treated_a, treated_b; 4 replicates each, unpaired, single batch, 12,000 genes), with a 12-row metadata table. The question is two-layered: (1) an omnibus test of whether any gene differs across the three groups at all, and (2) treatment-specific effects vs control. This maps directly onto a DESeq2 design ~condition with a likelihood-ratio test against the intercept-only model for the omnibus question, followed by two Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control) with log-fold-change shrinkage, which is the appropriate small-replicate (n=4/group) handling. A QC step first verifies the sample x condition mapping, filters low-expression genes, and checks sample clustering, because with 4 replicates per group a single outlier dominates inference. A final visualization step makes the per-treatment signatures comparable and quantifies shared vs treatment-specific responses. A supporting pathway step interprets each treatment's signature against the staged human WikiPathways gene sets; it is designed to degrade gracefully (report and skip) if gene identifiers in the counts matrix do not map to HGNC symbols. Because Salmon-derived gene counts may be non-integer depending on the (unrecorded) length correction, the DE step must check integrality and document how it handled it.
